Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of the straight line the returning damage travels along. Watch out for the return damage, which increases as your health gets lower. While Aurora W Across the Veil has her stealthed, don’t rush to use Illaoi E Test of Spirit; wait for her to reappear. When Aurora R Between Worlds opens, you’re slowed when leaving it, so back off before it appears or fight where your tentacles are.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building only health. Also consider movement speed to get out of its range.
Aurora.fight: Look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Aurora steps up to last-hit near a wall where you have a tentacle. After she uses a mobility ability to escape, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Fight from a position where your tentacles can hit both the spirit and Aurora.
Aurora.laning: When Aurora steps forward to last-hit, pressure her with Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your tentacles and turret. Don’t chase her into open ground without tentacles.
Aurora.escape: Once Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are both on cooldown, you have an opening to close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If only one mobility ability is down, she can still escape with the other, so don’t rush the chase.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, Illaoi has no reliable crowd control, so solo engages are less valuable. Focus on holding the frontline and counter-engaging.

Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main damage, so when you see him start casting, move outside the blade’s outer edge or move in close.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Illaoi’s main damage is also physical, and Aatrox has fairly high armor, so include penetration in your build. If the duel goes long, get Grievous Wounds to counter Aatrox’s healing.
Aatrox.laning: Pull the wave toward a tentacle area near a wall, then use Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Aatrox steps up to last-hit. Keep up the pressure without giving up an early kill.
Aatrox.combo: Damage Aatrox first, then pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your tentacle. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacle, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to draw out a series of slams.
Aatrox.escape: Right after Aatrox uses E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the gap, so go in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains might catch you, save Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to escape its area.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, watch out for Aatrox’s empowered basic attack and snowball potential. Avoid giving up a kill and focus on farming. In the late game, focus on the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Aatrox.teamfight: When your team engages or Aatrox goes in, hit the nearest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, immediately use Illaoi R Leap of Faith, then attack the spirit. When pulling a spirit, choose a position where your allies’ area-of-effect damage can hit both Aatrox and the spirit. Fight where you can keep enemies in range while your tentacles slam.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, the second dash follows. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking. When she goes in with Akali R Perfect Execution, counter-engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith where you have tentacles.
Akali.build: Get magic resistance first to deal with Akali’s main damage. Akali R Perfect Execution’s second hit deals damage based on your missing health, so build health as well.
Akali.fight: Pull the fight toward a wall where you have tentacles. When Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, pull her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and fight back. While Akali R Perfect Execution is down, look for a chance to close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Akali.combo: When Akali goes in, pull her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then first cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacle. Follow with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to close in and overlap your tentacle slams. In a teamfight where multiple enemies engage together, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith immediately after pulling a spirit, then attack it right away.
Akali.escape: Dodge the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip and check that Akali W Twilight Shroud is also down before looking for an opening. If only one mobility ability is down, she can escape with the other, so look to close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back.
Akali.phase: In the late game, focus on the frontline instead of engaging alone. Follow your team’s engage or counter-engage when the enemy goes in.
Akali.teamfight: Follow your team’s engage or, when Akali goes in, pull the nearest enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Immediately use Illaoi R Leap of Faith and attack the spirit to focus your tentacle damage. You can also use damage transfer by choosing a position where your allies’ area-of-effect damage hits both the spirit and Akali.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot starts from a wall, reaches a long distance, and stuns, so be careful not to get pushed toward a wall. When Camille goes in with R The Hextech Ultimatum, don’t use your response ability immediately. Wait out the duration of the enclosed area, then counterattack.
Camille.build: Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, W Tactical Sweep, and E Hookshot. Resistance can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, while Camille W Tactical Sweep scales with your maximum health, so be careful about building a lot of health alone. If you can reduce her attack speed, it will help you take fewer basic attacks.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. Fight where your tentacles can reach once it wears off. If Camille goes in with E Hookshot, pull her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your pre-placed tentacles and fight back. When a tentacle hits, Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God can heal you, so stay where your tentacles can reach.
Camille.laning: Early on, pressure Camille with Illaoi E Test of Spirit when she steps up to last-hit, and look for a chance to disrupt her farming before her first core item. Pull the wave into an area with your tentacles, but don’t get pushed toward a wall that gives Camille E Hookshot an engage angle. Keep up the lane pressure without forcing a dive.
Camille.combo: Then first cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacle, followed by Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to close in and keep the tentacle slams coming. If Camille has gone in, pull a spirit before using Illaoi R Leap of Faith to increase the number of tentacles.
Camille.escape: After Camille E Hookshot’s stun is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Camille can also move with R The Hextech Ultimatum, so don’t go deep just because E is down. In particular, look for an opening before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back.
Camille.phase: From mid game onward, Camille can quickly take side-lane turrets, so don’t leave the side lane unattended. In the late game, Illaoi should focus on the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Camille.teamfight: Pull the nearest enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then counter-engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith when your team goes in or Camille engages. Using R after pulling a spirit creates more tentacles, and you can add more damage if your allies’ area-of-effect abilities can hit both the spirit and Camille. Attack the spirit immediately during the brief window after R when your tentacles slam faster.

Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture telegraphs beneath your feet, so move sideways as soon as you see the marker. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you from the front, it is hard to dodge the follow-up Cho'Gath Q Rupture, so do not start trades from the front. If you are below half health, create distance to avoid the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first against Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and stacking health alone also increases the damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, which scales with maximum health.
Chogath.laning: Early on, place tentacles near a wall and pull the wave into that area. Look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Cho'Gath steps up to last-hit, but move out of the line behind minions pierced by Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Right after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave is your chance to pressure him or set up a gank.
Chogath.combo: Dodge Cho'Gath's crowd control, then pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction the tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson so the tentacle slams overlap.
Chogath.escape: Move sideways when you see the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, and save Illaoi W Harsh Lesson's dash for when you need it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, walk out first instead of trying to cast an ability. Engage during the window after Cho'Gath Q Rupture or Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is used.
Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger over time, putting you at a disadvantage, so focus on playing the frontline in the late game instead of making reckless solo engages.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with Darius W Crippling Strike and Darius Q Decimate, so harass from outside E range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move beyond the blade or hug him to get hit by the handle. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to break them; if you are low on health with several stacks, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Also get health to account for the penetration on Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Since Darius has high armor, include penetration when increasing your damage.
Darius.fight: After Darius E Apprehend is used, take short trades near a wall with tentacles. Right after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions, pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and pressure him. Once Hemorrhage stacks start building, end the extended trade, back off, then fight again.
Darius.combo: When Darius E Apprehend is used, pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction the tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to continue the tentacle slams. If Darius uses Q Decimate, use W to hug him and avoid the blade.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. You can also close the distance with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson while Darius R Noxian Guillotine is on cooldown. If Darius E Apprehend is still available, do not use W first; save it so you can respond.

Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and strikes back, so do not rush Illaoi E Test of Spirit while it is available. If Fiora dives toward a vital, stand on the opposite side to narrow her angle, and when she uses Fiora R Grand Challenge, hug a wall to block one side of the vitals.
Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Fiora W Riposte or the true damage from vitals, and Fiora R Grand Challenge scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If the duel goes long, get resistance before considering Grievous Wounds.
Fiora.fight: Take the fight near a wall where your tentacles are positioned when Fiora steps up to last-hit or comes in toward a vital. After Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are used, pull her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Fiora.laning: Look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit as Fiora steps forward to last-hit, but if Fiora W Riposte is available, first look for a chance to bait it out. After a short trade, do not chase recklessly; keep up the pressure.
Fiora.combo: When Fiora W Riposte is used, pull her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction the tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson so the slams overlap. If Fiora dives deep into the tentacle area, pull her spirit, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and immediately attack the spirit.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora uses Q Lunge is your chance to close the distance, so use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to get on her. If Fiora W Riposte is also used, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit and fight in the tentacle area.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora uses Fiora R Grand Challenge on Illaoi, hug a wall so you do not expose all four vitals. Rather than going in alone, respond to your team's engage or the enemy's engage by pulling the nearest enemy's spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith and attack the spirit. Fight where you can keep enemies from spreading out while the summoned tentacles slam quickly.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target and deals damage based on current health. When you are at high health, dodge it with minions between you and Dr. Mundo. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so do not spend time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Armor cannot mitigate the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw or W Heart Zapper. If the duel goes long, get resistance before preparing Grievous Wounds.
DrMundo.fight: Lure Dr. Mundo into a fight near a wall where an Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God tentacle is positioned. Lower his health first, then pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and attack in succession with Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash and W Harsh Lesson. Look for a kill during the window when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.laning: Look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Dr. Mundo steps up to last-hit, and block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions. After a trade, step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.combo: Lower Dr. Mundo's health first, then pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit near your tentacles. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash in the direction of the tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap the slams. If Dr. Mundo comes in to fight, pull his spirit, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and immediately attack the spirit.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have an angle to get on him, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions; the window when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down is an especially good time to engage.
DrMundo.phase: In the late game, Illaoi should play on the frontline instead of going in alone, and if Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available, do not spend time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.teamfight: Pull the nearest enemy's spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith to counterengage when the enemy goes in or your team engages. Then attack the spirit and heal by hitting enemy champions with tentacle slams. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, do not spend time chasing him down to kill him.

Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg gets more dangerous as it ages, so back away when an armed keg is nearby and don’t step where two kegs overlap.
Gangplank.build: Gangplank Q Parrrley keeps up the poke, so build armor first from the laning phase. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so build health as well. If the fight drags on and the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy becomes a problem, consider Executioner's Calling for its Grievous Wounds.
Gangplank.fight: Trade right after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg, before it arms. Pull the spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near a wall where your tentacles are, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Avoid fighting if an armed keg is nearby or your tentacles can’t reach.
Gangplank.laning: When Gangplank steps forward to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit. If Gangplank has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg, pressure him before it arms. Keep up the pressure in an area covered by your tentacles without forcing a dive.
Gangplank.combo: Pull the spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit from the side where your tentacles are. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Casting Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first makes a tentacle slam overlap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson when it lands. Start this sequence while Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and hasn’t armed yet.
Gangplank.escape: The moment Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg is your chance to engage; wait if an armed keg is nearby. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson when you have an opening. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy cleanses crowd control, so don’t rely on the slow from Illaoi E Test of Spirit alone to hold him in place.
Gangplank.phase: Illaoi’s value as a solo engager falls off later, so play on the frontline and counter-engage when the enemy dives in.
Gangplank.teamfight: Hit the nearest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith to create a tentacle for the spirit hit as well, and attack the spirit immediately. Follow up on an ally’s engage or counter-engage when the enemy dives in instead of engaging alone first. Avoid spots where Gangplank E Powder Keg kegs overlap, and watch whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used to choose when to fight for an objective.

Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows you, and Mini Gnar’s boomerang can hit you on its way back, so move out of its path. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns enemies knocked into a wall, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall when his transformation is near.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main damage from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Gnar E Hop / Crunch, and Gnar R GNAR!. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Gnar.fight: Your chance to fight comes right after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar or after Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch. Pull the spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit where your tentacles are, and if Gnar has used his mobility, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Gnar.laning: When Gnar steps forward to last-hit, look for the spirit, but move out of the path of Mini Gnar’s returning boomerang.
Gnar.combo: When Gnar comes near your tentacles, pull the spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first toward your tentacles. Follow with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to close in and trigger consecutive tentacle slams.
Gnar.phase: Illaoi’s value as a solo engager falls off later, so play on the frontline and counter-engage when the enemy dives in.
Gnar.teamfight: Position yourself to avoid being stunned after Gnar R GNAR! knocks you into a wall, and don’t start fights in narrow terrain. When an ally engages or Gnar dives in, pull the spirit from the nearest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and attack the spirit immediately.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack silences you and prevents you from fighting back, so don’t engage first while it’s active. Don’t stay in range of Garen E Judgment for long, and delay your combo by half a beat right after Garen activates Garen W Courage. If you’re below half health, move out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.laning: When Garen steps up to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your tentacles and turret. Push or pressure the lane from early on to give Garen less time to stack Garen W Courage.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used, pull the spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first toward your tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap the tentacle slam. If Garen activates Garen W Courage, avoid engaging right after and deal damage later.
Garen.escape: Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used, you have a chance to close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. After engaging, fight in an area covered by your tentacles and don’t stay in range of Garen E Judgment for long.
Garen.phase: Garen W Courage’s stacks are permanent, putting you at a greater disadvantage as time passes. Later, focus on the frontline role instead of engaging alone.
Garen.teamfight: Pull the spirit from the nearest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then immediately cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith to create more tentacles and attack the spirit. Use it when an ally engages or the enemy dives in, and choose a spot where the spirit and champion can both be hit by your allies’ area damage. You also need a way to keep enemies in place while Illaoi R Leap of Faith’s tentacles deal heavy damage.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce holds his cannon, watch for ranged poke. If you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, sidestep out of the line of the Jayce Q Shock Blast that follows. When he holds his hammer, prepare for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast deals physical damage, so magic resistance won’t block it. Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Jayce.fight: When Jayce steps forward to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from the side where your tentacles are. If Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson and fight on top of your tentacles.
Jayce.laning: Against Jayce’s strong early poke, move side to side and farm defensively. Pull the wave toward your tentacles placed near a wall, and look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Jayce steps up to last-hit. If you’ve lost a lot of health, don’t stay and force it; clear the wave and return.
Jayce.combo: Wear down Jayce first, then pull the spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first toward your tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap the tentacle slam.
Jayce.escape: Right after Jayce Q To the Skies! is used, you have a chance to close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is also down, hold Jayce in place and fight where your tentacles are.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm and hold on even if you fall behind; don’t force a comeback. Later, play on the frontline and counter-engage when the enemy dives in instead of engaging alone.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for an opening when Jayce Q To the Skies! is used, and counter-engage when the enemy dives into an area covered by your tentacles. Hit the nearest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and attack the spirit immediately. If the enemy spreads out, Illaoi R Leap of Faith’s brief damage window is wasted, so time it with an ally’s engage.

Irelia.watch: Irelia repeatedly closes in by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on low-health minions, so create distance as minions are about to die. Dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun. If you’re trapped by Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Since basic attacks and attack speed are the core of her damage, reducing her attack speed is also effective.
Irelia.fight: Meet Irelia’s engage near tentacles set up by a wall. Right after she uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, then pull her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and fight.
Irelia.laning: Set up a tentacle near a wall and draw the wave toward it, then use Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Irelia steps up to last-hit. Don’t leave a low-health minion between you, and watch for Irelia Q Bladesurge’s chained engages as minions are about to die.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to engage with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun, then fight where your tentacles are.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, fight from the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact in teamfights, so focus Irelia first. Hit the closest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith and attack the spirit. Use it to counter-engage or follow up on an ally’s engage.

Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and stuns in an area when reactivated. Don’t basic attack while it’s active, and move out of the stun radius. Since Jax Q Leap Strike can close the gap, check whether Jax E Counter Strike is still active after he jumps before deciding when to fight.
Jax.build: Prioritize defensive items that can reduce Jax’s attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health stack alone.
Jax.fight: Counter Jax’s approach where Illaoi’s tentacles are set up near a wall. When Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson; create distance and start trading with Illaoi E Test of Spirit after Counter Strike ends. If Jax engages, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith to fight where your tentacles can reach.
Jax.laning: Pressure Jax with Illaoi E Test of Spirit when he steps up to last-hit.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike, you can exploit the opening while his mobility is down. Wait until the stun from Jax E Counter Strike has also ended, then close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax dives in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group with your allies; avoid the area stun. After the stun ends, follow up on your allies’ crowd control with Illaoi E Test of Spirit to pull a spirit, then counter-engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith where enemies are grouped. Attack the spirit where your summoned tentacles can reach, and hold the frontline.

Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so walk sideways to dodge it. Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist can’t be targeted from outside the mist, so enter it or wait until it ends before using your abilities. Also watch out for the slow and maximum-health damage from Gwen R Needlework.
Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first, such as Spectre’s Cowl, to mitigate Gwen’s main damage. Armor also helps against her basic attacks’ physical damage, and reducing her attack speed can lower how often she hits you. Gwen’s high armor can blunt Illaoi’s physical damage, so include penetration in your build.
Gwen.fight: Right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is on cooldown, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson in an area covered by your tentacles. Walk sideways to dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and if Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, wait before using attacks that require a target from outside the mist. If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits, look for a position where both the spirit and Gwen will be hit by tentacle attacks.
Gwen.laning: If Gwen steps up to last-hit before Gwen Q Snip Snip! has built up stacks, pressure her with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Stay outside Gwen’s basic attack range to stop her healing, and keep up the pressure without forcing a dive.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is her only mobility tool, so right after she uses it is your chance to close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. While slowed by Gwen R Needlework, fight where your tentacles can reach rather than chasing recklessly. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, move somewhere she can be targeted or wait until it ends.
Gwen.phase: Watch her stacks. In the late game, have Illaoi meet Gwen’s engage from the frontline instead of engaging alone.

KSante.watch: If you’re hit by consecutive casts of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, move out of range to avoid the next pull and stun. When you see K'Sante W Path Maker charging, don’t commit your damage; sidestep the direction of the dash. Don’t face off with a wall at your back, or K'Sante R All Out could knock you over it.
KSante.build: K'Sante has high armor, so prioritize penetration to make Illaoi’s physical damage count. If you build resistance, choose armor over magic resistance, and get enough health to withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker. If crowd control is getting you killed, you can prioritize tenacity.
KSante.fight: Draw K'Sante into an area covered by tentacles, then pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit to trade. While K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, hold your damage and dodge the dash before counterattacking. When K'Sante R All Out is active, focus your damage on his reduced defenses, but don’t try to absorb his increased damage and healing alone.
KSante.laning: Bring the wave toward the tentacles near a wall, then use Illaoi E Test of Spirit when K'Sante steps up to last-hit. Fight near your tentacles, but avoid positions where K'Sante R All Out can knock you over a wall.
KSante.combo: After hitting K'Sante with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction of your tentacles. Follow with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to close in and overlap the tentacle slam. If K'Sante engages and starts a teamfight, hit the closest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, immediately use Illaoi R Leap of Faith, then attack the spirit.
KSante.escape: If only one of K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork is on cooldown, he can still escape with the other mobility tool, so don’t rush your engage.
KSante.phase: In the late game, meet the enemy’s engage from the frontline instead of engaging alone.
KSante.teamfight: Pull the closest enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith to summon more tentacles, then attack the spirit. Counter K'Sante when he engages, and don’t commit your damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging. When K'Sante R All Out is active, attack with your allies. If the fight is likely to last, make sure your team has a source of Grievous Wounds.

Kennen.watch: Kennen P Mark of the Storm stuns after three stacks, so back off after being hit twice and wait for the stacks to wear off. Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken only hits the first target, so dodge it from behind minions. When Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom dives in, don’t stand clumped with your allies.
Kennen.build: Build movement speed first so you can leave the telegraphed area, then build magic resistance to prepare for Kennen’s damage.
Kennen.fight: Once Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and the stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm have worn off, fight with Illaoi E Test of Spirit from the side with your tentacles. If Kennen dives in, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson and land a tentacle slam at the same time.
Kennen.laning: Place a tentacle near a wall and pull the wave toward it. When Kennen steps up to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit.
Kennen.combo: After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, pull out his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Use Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction your tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap the tentacle slam.
Kennen.escape: If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off to avoid the third hit and wait for the stacks to wear off. After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and watch for where Kennen may dive. When he goes in, hit a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then counter with Illaoi R Leap of Faith and immediately attack the spirit.

Kayle.build: Build movement speed first to get out of Kayle’s area damage. Build magic resistance to defend against her magic damage, and dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast to preserve that resistance.
Kayle.fight: After learning Illaoi E Test of Spirit, trade near your tentacles. When Kayle steps up to last-hit, pull out her spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to follow with a tentacle slam. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, hold your damage until the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.laning: Place a tentacle near a wall and pull the wave toward it. When Kayle steps up to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit.
Kayle.combo: When trading with Kayle, pull out her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash in the direction your tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Casting Q first lets you overlap a tentacle slam when W connects. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, deal damage after the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.escape: Dodge the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast before engaging. Kayle may use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to gain movement speed and escape, so when going in with your jungler, land an ally’s immobilizing crowd control first. When you have a chance to stick to her, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Kayle.teamfight: Kayle attacks from the backline, so coordinate a path to reach her and your crowd control timing with your allies to avoid getting stuck on the frontline for too long. Instead of engaging alone, follow an ally’s engage or the enemy’s engage: cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit on the nearest enemy and counter with Illaoi R Leap of Faith. Focus your damage after the invulnerability from Kayle R Divine Judgment ends.

Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, back off so you don’t take its fourth basic attack, which deals damage based on your maximum health, then re-engage. Also watch for Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! starting from out of vision.
Kled.build: Prioritize armor because the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting is physical. Armor does not block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and since Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on maximum health, avoid stacking a lot of health alone. Attack speed reduction buys time before Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth basic attack.
Kled.fight: Fight near a wall where your tentacles are set, and draw Kled there. If Kled engages with Kled E Jousting, pull out his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and counter where your tentacles can reach. Don’t keep taking all four basic attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies; create distance during its dangerous window.
Kled.laning: Cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Kled steps up to last-hit. If you dismount him, push him out of lane so he can’t build Courage by killing minions. If his Courage is full and you can’t prevent him from remounting, create distance.
Kled.combo: Pull out Kled’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash in the direction your tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Casting Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first lets you overlap a tentacle slam when Illaoi W Harsh Lesson connects. If Kled engages on top of your tentacles and a major fight breaks out, pull out his spirit, cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and immediately attack the spirit.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down. Look for a window when Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is also unavailable, then close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, prioritize getting out before the pull triggers.
Kled.phase: Kled weakens sharply after the laning phase and mid game, so in the late game Illaoi should focus on playing the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Kled.teamfight: Since Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can start from out of vision, use side-lane vision to spot his engage early. When Kled goes in, pull out a nearby enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and counter with Illaoi R Leap of Faith. You can also follow an ally’s engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith, then attack a spirit where your summoned tentacles can reach.

Malphite.watch: Don’t start a trade immediately after being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, since the slow makes it hard to engage or retreat. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be interrupted while dashing, so when you don’t know where he is, don’t stand clumped with allies near walls or bushes.
Malphite.build: Prioritize magic resistance to withstand the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Malphite W Thunderclap deals physical damage, which magic resistance can’t block. Against Malphite’s high armor, build some penetration or use the maximum-health damage from Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, and start trades when you haven’t been hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard. Cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from the side with your tentacles so you can fight on top of them even if Malphite engages. If he engages first, counter with Illaoi R Leap of Faith.
Malphite.laning: Pull the wave toward an area near a wall where your tentacles are set. When Malphite steps up to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, pull out his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Use Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction your tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap the tentacle slam. If Malphite engages and starts a team fight, pull out a nearby enemy’s spirit, immediately cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith, then attack the spirit.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up several of you. After Malphite dashes in, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit on a nearby enemy and counter with Illaoi R Leap of Faith to summon more tentacles. Fight back by attacking the spirit where the tentacles are, and don’t cast your ultimate when engaging alone.

Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Mordekaiser’s main ability damage. Invest in armor too, since his basic attacks deal damage, but avoid stacking only health because Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on your max health. Consider healing reduction to counter Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s healing.
Mordekaiser.fight: Lure Mordekaiser to fight near a wall where your tentacles are. Dodge Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, then land Illaoi E Test of Spirit and trade briefly before backing off ahead of Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activating. Focus your damage after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield wears down or converts into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: When Mordekaiser steps up to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from the side with your tentacles and turret. Pressure him by holding your tentacle zone instead of forcing a dive.
Mordekaiser.escape: A missed Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is your chance to engage. Apply a slow and mark with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, and close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson if Mordekaiser tries to retreat. Don’t go deep alone while Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready.
Mordekaiser.phase: In the mid game, pressure from your tentacle zone. In the late game, meet the enemy engage from the frontline instead of going in alone.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp doesn’t pull several of you in together. Pull the spirit of a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith and hit the spirit when the enemy engages or your allies go in. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death catches you, don’t count on your allies to help; avoid being alone within its range.

Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as it stacks, so pressure him from the early game to keep him from last-hitting freely. Nasus W Wither slows you and makes it hard to retreat, so don’t stay in range alone for long. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands activates, don’t start a new fight; wait out its duration.
Nasus.build: Build armor first to counter Nasus’s main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands, so it’s also important to leave the area covered by Nasus E Spirit Fire. Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking only health.
Nasus.fight: Once you’ve learned Illaoi E Test of Spirit, trade from the side with your tentacles when Nasus steps up to last-hit. If Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands isn’t active, close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to pressure him. You can use the healing from tentacle slams to trade back where your tentacles can reach, but don’t chase him to fight where you have no tentacles.
Nasus.laning: In the early game, place tentacles near a wall and pull the wave toward them to pressure Nasus Q Siphoning Strike last-hits. Don’t leave the wave under Nasus’s turret for long, as it’s easy for him to stack safely there. If the wave comes toward your side, call for a jungle gank and look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Nasus steps forward to last-hit.
Nasus.escape: When Nasus W Wither is down, you have a good window to close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Nasus has no way to create distance on his own besides Flash, so if Illaoi E Test of Spirit lands while you’re near your tentacles, follow through with the engage. Don’t start a fight during that window if Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.phase: You become less favored as the game goes on because of Nasus Q Siphoning Strike’s stacks, so build an advantage early.
Nasus.teamfight: While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, keep your distance and wait out its duration instead of facing him head-on. If enemies engage, pull a spirit and counter with Illaoi R Leap of Faith, then hit a target your tentacles can reach.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, helping him close in. Move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. During Olaf R Ragnarok, create distance instead of relying on Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s slow, and remember that armor can’t reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Olaf.build: Build armor first to counter Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Get enough health to withstand the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, and consider ways to reduce his attack speed since basic attacks make up a large part of his damage.
Olaf.fight: Lure Olaf to fight near a wall where your tentacles are. Prevent him from retrieving Olaf Q Undertow’s axe, then pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to trigger tentacle attacks. Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal when his health is low, so don’t chase recklessly where your tentacles can’t reach.
Olaf.laning: In the early game, don’t give up kills and pull the wave toward a wall where your tentacles are. When Olaf steps up to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from the side with your tentacles and turret. Move opposite where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it and closing in again.
Olaf.escape: The moment Olaf can’t retrieve his Olaf Q Undertow axe is your chance to close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Olaf has no skill to create distance on his own, but if Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance first and wait out its duration. Once R ends, apply Illaoi E Test of Spirit and engage.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so don’t give up kills and manage the lane from your tentacle zone. Olaf’s relative strength falls in the late game, and Illaoi should meet engages from the frontline instead of going in alone.
Olaf.teamfight: When your allies engage or Olaf approaches, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit on the nearest enemy and counter with Illaoi R Leap of Faith. Immediately attack the pulled spirit to transfer tentacle damage to the champion as well. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t keep letting him hit you; create distance, then catch him with Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s slow once R ends.

Ornn.watch: Near the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and near walls, Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up, so move toward open ground. Keep your distance if the final breath of Ornn W Bellows Breath hits you and makes you Brittle. Also move out of the straight line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn.
Ornn.fight: Cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from the side with your tentacles when Ornn steps up to last-hit. Once both Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Fight where your tentacles can reach so you can heal with Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God.
Ornn.laning: Pull the wave toward the area where you’ve placed tentacles, but don’t stand right against a wall where Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up. When a pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture appears, move away from it. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, get close and attack to interrupt him.
Ornn.escape: If only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, so don’t rush your engage. Look especially for the window before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up, and close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson while his mobility is down.
Ornn.phase: In the late game, Illaoi gets less value from engaging alone, so meet the enemy engage from the frontline.
Ornn.teamfight: Pull the nearest enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, and when the enemy engages, cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith and immediately attack the spirit. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes, move out of the straight line between the spirit and Ornn, and prepare for the recast spirit as well. The heavy damage from tentacles after Illaoi R Leap of Faith lasts only briefly, so attack before enemies can walk away and spread out.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to counter Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.fight: When Poppy steps up to last-hit near your tentacles, start a trade with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait to dash in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, then close the distance after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. If you’re within tentacle range, trade back even at low health and use the healing from tentacle slams.
Poppy.laning: Pull the wave toward your tentacles, but keep open space behind you so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t knock you into a wall. When Poppy steps forward to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your tentacles and turret. When the shield Poppy P Iron Ambassador throws lands, step on it first to prevent her from gaining a shield.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, pull out her spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction your tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to chain tentacle slams. If Poppy comes onto your tentacles and you need to trade back, pull out her spirit, cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and attack the spirit immediately.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, solo engages are less valuable, so focus on counter-engaging from the frontline.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so don’t let him get in range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces, so don’t cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash from the front; wait for it to end or angle in from the side. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall grants armor penetration, so be cautious about stacking too much health or armor alone. Pantheon’s high armor can blunt Illaoi’s physical damage, so include penetration in your damage build.
Pantheon.fight: After Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, you have a chance to close the distance with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don’t rush a frontal attack; wait for it to end or attack from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Use minions as cover to reduce the long-range poke damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Keep the wave near a wall and your tentacles, and cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Pantheon steps forward to last-hit. It’s safer to pull out his spirit near your turret and tentacles.
Pantheon.combo: Lower Pantheon’s health first, then pull out his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction your tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to continue the tentacle slams. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks frontal damage, wait for it to end or change your attack angle.
Pantheon.escape: The window to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Close the distance with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson near your tentacles during this window. If only Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, Pantheon can escape with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, so watch for his remaining mobility as well.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s impact falls off in the late game, while Illaoi should focus on counter-engaging from the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Pantheon.teamfight: When Pantheon or another enemy engages, use Illaoi E Test of Spirit on the nearest enemy, then cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith immediately so the spirit also contributes to the tentacle summon. Then attack the spirit, but avoid the direction Pantheon E Aegis Assault faces or wait for the ability to end. After Illaoi R Leap of Faith, time your fight with your allies’ engage and crowd control while the tentacles slam rapidly.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move outside her basic attack range so you don’t get hit by the empowered attack. Avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind minions, and don’t force your way in while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.build: Quinn’s main damage is physical, so buy armor items first and build armor. Magic resistance won’t help against her damage.
Quinn.fight: Close the distance with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson right after Quinn E Vault is down. Fight near a wall with tentacles after hitting Quinn with Illaoi E Test of Spirit.
Quinn.laning: Early on, respect Quinn’s range, preserve your health, and collect CS. Pull the wave toward a wall with tentacles and look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Quinn steps up to last-hit. If Quinn P Harrier marks you, back off, then farm while the mark is gone.
Quinn.combo: Pull out a spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If Quinn comes close and you need to trade back, pull out her spirit, cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and attack the spirit immediately.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is a mobility spell that knocks her away from an enemy she’s close to, so don’t force an engage before it’s used. Close the distance with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson right after Quinn uses Quinn E Vault.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Illaoi needs to preserve her health and farm because of Quinn’s range. Later, watch for roams with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines, and in the late game, fight from the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Quinn.teamfight: Pull out the nearest enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. When the enemy engages, counter-engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith, then attack the spirit.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is above or near half, stay out of range to avoid an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash if the first hits a unit, so don’t stand in or behind your minion wave.
Renekton.build: Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus, and an empowered second dash from Renekton E Slice and Dice shreds armor. Prioritize positioning to avoid that dash over stacking more armor.
Renekton.fight: Trade near your tentacles when Renekton is out of Fury. After he uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice, trade back. In particular, if he used Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage, close the distance with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Where your tentacles can reach, trade back and use the healing from their slams.
Renekton.laning: When Renekton steps forward to last-hit or build Fury, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit near your tentacles and turret. Stand outside or in front of your minion wave so Renekton E Slice and Dice can’t use it as a stepping stone to engage.
Renekton.combo: Lower Renekton’s health first, then pull out his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit near your tentacles. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first in the direction your tentacles are facing, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to chain the tentacle slams.
Renekton.escape: The window to engage is right after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage and has no mobility left. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, close the distance with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson near your tentacles and trade back.
Renekton.phase: If you avoid giving Renekton kills and keep scaling, his value falls off after the mid game. In the late game, Illaoi should focus on playing the frontline instead of engaging alone.

Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings can chain dashes and knock you airborne, while Riven W Ki Burst can stun you, so create distance as soon as you see the first dash. Riven R Blade of the Exile increases her attack damage and range, and its damage based on your missing health is also dangerous, so keep your distance until it expires.
Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, move armor items earlier in your build, and get enough health to avoid being finished off after Riven R Blade of the Exile takes you low.
Riven.fight: The window to trade is after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Pull her soul with Illaoi E Test of Spirit near a wall with a tentacle, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith to counterattack if Riven goes in.
Riven.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward a wall with a tentacle planted and fight there. When Riven steps up to last-hit, use Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your tentacle and turret to pressure her without forcing a dive.
Riven.combo: After pulling Riven’s soul with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward the tentacle, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to keep the tentacle slams coming. If Riven goes in where she can hit multiple tentacles, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith while the soul is pulled, then attack the soul immediately.
Riven.escape: Don’t go in just because one Riven Q Broken Wings charge is down; check how Riven used Riven E Valor as well. In particular, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson when Riven Q Broken Wings is still on cooldown and Riven W Ki Burst is also down.
Riven.phase: In the late game, take the frontline and counter the enemy’s engage instead of going in alone.
Riven.teamfight: Pull the soul of a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith when the enemy goes in to summon tentacles and attack the soul. If Riven is close, watch out for the dashes from Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven W Ki Burst, and fight where your summoned tentacles can reach.

Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, Shen Q Twilight Assault-enhanced attacks are likely to hit. Move out of the dash path and the path of Shen’s spirit blade as it returns to him. When Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, attacks are blocked, so deal damage with abilities such as Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash.
Shen.build: The time you spend locked down by Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t build resistance to only one type. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Shen.fight: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, it’s a chance to close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Pull his soul with Illaoi E Test of Spirit near your tentacles, then follow up with Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Avoid fighting in open areas where your tentacles can’t reach.
Shen.laning: Pressure Shen with Illaoi E Test of Spirit when he steps up to last-hit. If you take lane control and keep Shen occupied with CS, using Shen R Stand United to intervene in another lane will cost him more.
Shen.combo: Pull Shen’s soul with Illaoi E Test of Spirit where your tentacles are. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward the tentacles first, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to continue the slams. Your ability damage still goes through while Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is a window to go in. Close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson and fight where your tentacles are. If Shen R Stand United is also down and unavailable, you can take advantage of the opening while he has no mobility abilities.
Shen.teamfight: Don’t engage alone first; follow up on an ally’s engage or counterattack when the enemy goes in with Shen E Shadow Dash. Hit a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith to summon more tentacles and attack the soul immediately. Alert your team as soon as Shen disappears from lane or you see Shen R Stand United’s channel.

Rumble.watch: If you’re hit by the first Rumble E Electro Harpoon, immediately create distance or move with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson before the second shot comes. Watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer as well.
Rumble.build: Prioritize magic resistance on your defensive items. Most of Rumble’s damage is magic, and Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Rumble.fight: Make Rumble walk toward a wall near your tentacles before fighting. Don’t unload damage right after Rumble W Scrap Shield activates; wait briefly. Once the shield and movement speed boost are gone, pull his soul with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Rumble.laning: Plant a tentacle near a wall and pull the wave that way, then look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Rumble steps forward to last-hit. Lower Rumble’s health first to kill the soul faster.
Rumble.combo: After Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield expires, pull his soul with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward the tentacles first, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to keep the tentacle slams coming.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the window to close in is when Rumble W Scrap Shield’s movement speed boost wears off. If you’re hit by the first Rumble E Electro Harpoon, don’t wait for the second shot; move with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson or create distance immediately.
Rumble.phase: In the late game, fight on the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Rumble.teamfight: Pull the soul of the closest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith when the enemy engages or an ally goes in, and hit the soul immediately. Look for a position where your allies’ area damage hits both the soul and its owner, and keep enemies within tentacle range while the tentacles slam rapidly.

Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after Sett has taken a lot of damage, so if you deal heavy damage, create distance and wait for his Grit to fade. If it’s hard to dodge, move to the side of the indicator to avoid the center’s true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if it catches enemies on both sides, so don’t stand between a minion wave and Sett.
Sett.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Consider attack speed reduction to reduce damage that relies on basic attacks and attack speed. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your max health, and resistance can’t reduce the true damage in the center of Sett W Haymaker, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.fight: Pull Sett toward a wall where your tentacles are and fight there. Lower Sett’s health first, then hit him with Illaoi E Test of Spirit to kill the soul faster.
Sett.laning: When Sett steps up to last-hit, use Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your tentacles and turret. To avoid being stunned by Sett E Facebreaker, don’t stand on the opposite side of the minions with Sett between you and them.
Sett.escape: While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, he has no way to dash in, so close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. It’s also a window to go in after Sett E Facebreaker is down or when you’re positioned to avoid its stun condition on both sides. Delay your engage when Sett’s Grit is high, such as right before Sett W Haymaker, and move out of the center of its indicator.
Sett.phase: In the late game, Illaoi has no guaranteed crowd control, so take the frontline and receive the enemy’s engage instead of going in alone.
Sett.teamfight: Pull the soul of a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith when the enemy goes in to summon more tentacles and hit the soul immediately. When you pull a soul, check whether your allies’ area abilities can hit both it and its owner. Position yourself to avoid the stun on both sides of Sett E Facebreaker, and move out of the center of the indicator when Sett W Haymaker is cast.

Singed.watch: Following Singed Q Poison Trail makes you keep walking through the poison, so don’t chase even if his health looks low unless you can deal enough damage to finish him. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson can’t dash on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and Singed E Fling roots you if it hits while you’re on it, so go around areas covered by the adhesive. If Singed is facing away from your team, stay out of range of being thrown into them by Singed E Fling.
Singed.build: Get movement speed first so you can walk out of Singed Q Poison Trail when it’s telegraphed. Singed deals magic damage, so build magic resistance. Since Singed E Fling deals damage based on your max health, don’t invest too heavily in health alone.
Singed.fight: Fight where tentacles can reach so you can pull a spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. When Singed comes in, use Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap the tentacle slam.
Singed.laning: Pull the wave to a tentacle area near a wall, then cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Singed steps up to last-hit. Keep up the pressure where your tentacles are instead of chasing or diving recklessly.
Singed.escape: Use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to close the gap when Singed W Mega Adhesive is down or you’re clear of the adhesive, and Singed E Fling is no threat. Even after closing in, don’t chase for long through Singed Q Poison Trail; fight where your tentacles can reach.
Singed.phase: In the late game, solo engages are less valuable, so hold the frontline and respond to the enemy’s engage.
Singed.teamfight: Pull the spirit of a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith to counter-engage when enemies come in and hit the spirit. Instead of chasing Singed to the end, attack his allies while your team holds him in place. Fight in coordination with your team’s crowd control so enemies can’t walk away during the brief window when tentacles slam quickly after Illaoi R Leap of Faith.

Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes more dangerous the longer it charges, with a knock-up and stun, so move sideways when he starts charging. Avoid meeting Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in narrow paths, and dodge to the side when he charges at you. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor and slows you if it hits, so avoid it whenever possible. If Sion revives with Sion P Glory in Death, don’t continue fighting there; reposition.
Sion.build: Build armor first against Sion’s main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and E also reduces your armor, so dodging it takes priority. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about building health alone.
Sion.fight: Pull the fight to a spot near a wall where your tentacles are, then cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Sion steps up to last-hit. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage to break the shield immediately and prevent the explosion. If you dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash or Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson and fight.
Sion.laning: Pull the wave into a section near the wall with tentacles and look for E when Sion goes to last-hit. Sion’s max health increases as he kills units, so disrupt his farming but avoid reckless dives.
Sion.combo: Lower Sion’s health first, then pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward the tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap the tentacle slam. If Sion comes in and starts a team fight, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith immediately after pulling a spirit with E, then hit the spirit.
Sion.escape: Dodge to the side while Sion Q Decimating Smash is charging, or get close to make him use it early, then start the fight.
Sion.phase: As time passes, Sion’s max health keeps increasing from farming, so maintain pressure or create an advantage in another lane. In the late game, Illaoi should counter the enemy’s engage from the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Sion.teamfight: When Sion engages or your team engages, hit a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith. Using R while a spirit is present increases the number of tentacles summoned, so hit the spirit immediately. After Sion goes down, move away from where he revives with Sion P Glory in Death and reposition.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain and stuns if he hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to a wall even when fighting near your tentacles. Skarner R Impale suppresses you and can’t be removed with a movement ability like Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, so keep your distance from Skarner and his allies.
Skarner.fight: Where your tentacles can reach, pull Skarner’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit when he steps up to last-hit and start the trade. Once Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, but watch the range of Skarner R Impale’s suppression. Don’t follow him out into open ground where there are no tentacles.
Skarner.laning: Keep your tentacles near a wall, but don’t stand with your back to the wall, to avoid being stunned by Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Pressure the opponent and look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when they step forward to last-hit.
Skarner.combo: Pull Skarner’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash first toward the tentacles. Follow with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to close in and overlap nearby tentacle slams. If Skarner engages and starts a team fight, use Illaoi R Leap of Faith while the spirit is pulled, then attack it immediately.
Skarner.escape: The moment after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down is an opportunity to engage with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Even then, manage your distance if Skarner R Impale could pull you toward his allies, and fight where your tentacles can reach.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, focus on countering the enemy’s engage from the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Skarner.teamfight: Hit a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith to summon tentacles and attack the spirit when the enemy engages. Position yourself so Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact can’t push you into a wall and Skarner R Impale can’t pull you into the enemy team. If the enemy walks out of tentacle range, Illaoi R Leap of Faith’s brief damage window is wasted, so don’t engage alone first.

Teemo.watch: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart hits, your basic attacks are nullified, so don’t try to auto-attack while blinded; deal damage with Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash or back off. Teemo E Toxic Shot keeps dealing poison damage after even one basic attack, so stay out of range until you’re ready to commit. Also watch for stealth in unwarded bushes and Teemo R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.build: Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Teemo has low armor, so Illaoi’s physical damage is effective against him.
Teemo.fight: Pull the fight to a spot near a wall where your tentacles are, then look for Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Teemo steps up to last-hit. Once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson and commit all at once. Tentacles heal when they hit enemy champions, so you can turn the fight even at low health where they can reach.
Teemo.laning: Pull the wave to a section near the wall where your tentacles are, then cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit when Teemo steps up to last-hit. Don’t pass by unwarded bushes; use a Control Ward or go around them.
Teemo.combo: Pull Teemo’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward the tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Casting Q first lets the tentacle slam follow as W arrives. While affected by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, deal damage with abilities instead of relying on basic attacks.
Teemo.escape: The moment after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is your chance to engage. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed but gives him no separate dash, so close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson once you’ve narrowed the gap.
Teemo.phase: In the late game, Illaoi’s solo engages are less valuable, so counter the enemy’s engage from the frontline.
Teemo.teamfight: Watch for Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow passages, and use Oracle Lens to check key routes. Hit the closest enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then use Illaoi R Leap of Faith and immediately hit the spirit when enemies group up and engage. Position yourself to pull a spirit where your allies’ area-of-effect abilities can hit both the champion and the spirit.

TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench hits you twice with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, step out of range and wait for the stacks to expire. When you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive’s dive animation, spread out from your allies to avoid the AoE knock-up. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for his ability to save an ally you’re trying to finish by swallowing them and granting a shield.
TahmKench.fight: Take fights near walls with tentacles so Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God can heal you as you deal heavy damage. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin turns damage into a shield or healing, so avoid short trades where you hit him and back away. If Tahm Kench has no stacks and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is on cooldown, use Illaoi E Test of Spirit to pull his spirit, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
TahmKench.laning: When Tahm Kench steps forward to last-hit, cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit from near your tentacles and turret. To kill the spirit quickly, damage Tahm Kench first, then pull his spirit.
TahmKench.escape: Engage when Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is on cooldown, making it harder for him to engage or escape. If he has no stacks from basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson; if he has hit you twice, back away first and wait for the stacks to expire.
TahmKench.phase: In the late game, Illaoi should counter-engage from the frontline rather than engage alone.
TahmKench.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit by Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive’s AoE knock-up. When your allies engage or the enemy team comes in, pull the nearest enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and counter-engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith. Deal AoE damage to the carry Tahm Kench is protecting rather than focusing only on Tahm Kench, while accounting for Tahm Kench R Devour being able to save the carry.

Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, so avoid trading right after it hits you. When Trundle W Frozen Domain is placed, move out of it. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice appears, move to the side before it slows you. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tankier, so create distance.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Reducing his attack speed is also effective. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals damage based on your maximum health, so first look to get out of R’s range instead of stacking more resistances or health.
Trundle.fight: Take the fight after avoiding Trundle E Pillar of Ice and Trundle W Frozen Domain near your tentacles. Trundle has no ability to create distance, so when you get an opening, pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit and close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If your tentacles can reach him, use the healing from their slams to fight back even at low health.
Trundle.laning: Place tentacles near walls, but avoid narrow paths where Trundle E Pillar of Ice could block your escape.
Trundle.combo: After pulling Trundle’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacles. Then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to overlap their slams. Even when countering Trundle’s engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith, pull his spirit with E first to summon more tentacles.
Trundle.escape: Engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is on cooldown and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Trundle has no ability to create distance, so if Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Trundle.phase: In the late game, prepare for teamfights around objectives with your team instead of facing Trundle alone in a side lane.
Trundle.teamfight: Pull the nearest enemy’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then counter-engage with Illaoi R Leap of Faith when the enemy team comes in to summon tentacles. If you pull the spirit where your allies’ AoE abilities can reach, they can hit both the champion and the spirit. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, stop focusing Trundle; attack another target or create distance while holding the frontline.

Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury makes his critical strikes dangerous as he builds Fury, so create distance when he starts building Fury by hitting minions. When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash brings him in, fight back near your tentacles. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop dealing more damage and create distance until it expires.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Thornmail is also effective because he relies heavily on basic attacks.
Tryndamere.fight: Near a wall with standing tentacles, start the trade by pulling Tryndamere’s spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit when he steps forward to last-hit.
Tryndamere.laning: Harass Tryndamere’s last-hitting from the start to reduce his Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. Create distance when he starts building Fury, before he can get on you.
Tryndamere.combo: Pull a spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson to follow up with tentacle slams. When Tryndamere engages Illaoi and the fight escalates, cast Illaoi R Leap of Faith while the spirit is pulled, then attack it immediately.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is on cooldown, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. When you need to account for Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing him to avoid the slow, and avoid trading basic attacks immediately after it hits.
Tryndamere.phase: In the late game, Illaoi has no reliable crowd control, so counter-engage from the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Hit a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then summon tentacles with Illaoi R Leap of Faith and attack the spirit. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t focus your damage on him; create distance and wait it out. Before going to kill Tryndamere in a side lane, check whether his R is available. If it is, send more allies or trade for an objective.

Udyr.watch: Watch for the stun on Udyr’s first attack right after he activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t fight him where there are no tentacles.
Udyr.build: Buy armor items first, and consider ways to reduce Udyr’s basic attack damage and attack speed. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so armor alone can’t block all his damage.
Udyr.fight: When Udyr engages, fight near a wall with tentacles and pull his spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit. After Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield expires, hit him hard with Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so ward key routes and jungle entrances, and don’t move forward when he’s out of sight. Pull the wave toward a wall with tentacles, then cast Illaoi E Test of Spirit when the enemy steps forward to last-hit.
Udyr.combo: Pull a spirit with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, cast Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash toward your tentacles, then close in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Casting Q first lets you trigger successive tentacle slams when W connects.
Udyr.escape: After you’ve taken one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, counterattack while he can’t immediately stun the same target again. Right after making Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede, close the gap with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, focus on holding the frontline instead of engaging alone.
Udyr.teamfight: Hit a nearby enemy with Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then summon tentacles with Illaoi R Leap of Faith and attack the spirit. Instead of forcing a kill on Udyr, who has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, clear the weaker enemies behind him first, then fight with a numbers advantage.

Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain stuns you on hit, and his leg cannons deal more damage the longer you stay near him. Avoid giving him an angle to engage and stay outside his short range. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it heavily slows you and makes you a target for Urgot W Purge, so decide immediately whether to disengage with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson as it comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, get completely out of range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
Urgot.build: Build armor first because most of Urgot’s damage is physical.
